plate_comment: Alpha ramp (e2m 104A +2 Alpha_Base, '[APAPBA] result of AFC, LSG, On Governor, and Fuel Rate alpha comparison'; alpha 16384 = 1.0 = open road, 0 = urban). Runs the alpha conditions that bits of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) enable and stores each result: 0x400 cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayA (low speed governor) into pressure_fuel_delay_a_status, 0x800 cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayB (air fuel control) into pressure_fuel_delay_b_status, 0x1000 cm848_calculateSensorEma (fuel rate) into alpha_fuel_rate_result, 0x2000 cm848_checkFuelRateCondition (on governor) into fuel_rate_condition_status and 0x8000 cm848_checkPressureHysteresis (low ambient air pressure) into pressure_hysteresis_state. When none of them is 1 alpha_base is reset to 0; otherwise it ramps up each pass by alpha_ramp_rate_below_threshold while it is below alpha_ramp_threshold and by alpha_ramp_rate_at_or_above_threshold from there on (e2m 104B +0 Alpha_Ramp_Rate_1 / +2 Alpha_Ramp_Rate_2 / +4 Alpha_Ramp_Threshold), capped at 16384. It then copies final_fueling_state to governor_mode_code_snapshot and clears alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag and alpha_air_fuel_control_state_detected_flag. Only caller hpcr_calculateFuelTrimOutput (every pass outside the engine states STOPPED, CRANKING and JUMP_START). Shared name with CM550 0xc582 (the same function). (was timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator)

Selects the alpha (0 = urban, 16384 = 1.0 = open road; e2m 104A +0 Alpha) and its source code (e2m 104A +4 Alpha_State) into combustion_alpha_input and governor_startup_state: 0 base (alpha_base), 1 user (fuel_blend_coefficient_startup_cal), 2 altitude (altitude_derate_alpha, e2m 104B +8), 3 engine protection (engine_protection_alpha, e2m 104B +12), 4 slave override (governor_startup_fuel_blend_coeff), 5 ESP (fuel_blend_coefficient_run_cal). In the engine states STOPPED, CRANKING and JUMP_START it preloads cold_start_timer_a / _b with low_speed_governor_alpha_timeout / air_fuel_control_alpha_timeout (active flags 1), clears alpha_altitude_derate_timer, alpha_filtered_fuel_delivery_rate, the fuel rate filter accumulator, alpha_base and governor_mode_code_snapshot; in every other state it runs timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator (the alpha ramp). Source priority, tested in this order (disassembly 0xe5b4-0xe6fc): master_slave_override_enable_flag nonzero -> 4; bit 0x8000 of governor_feature_config_flags set and governor_startup_threshold = 0x4000 -> 5; mask 0x01 of governor_feature_flags set -> 1; cm848_checkPressureFuelState nonzero (altitude derate latched) -> 2; mask 0x4000 of governor_fault_status_flags set and fault_derate_active_flag = 1, unless alpha_altitude_derate_timer is nonzero while mask 0x20 of feature_enable_flags_cal is set -> 3; else 0. The alpha is limited to 16384 and copied to thermal_fuel_limit_factor (e2m 1053 +2 Fuel_Interp_Factor) unless bit 0x10 of algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal (ESP enable) is set. Caller main_loop. Shared name with CM550 0xc326 (the same function). (was hpcr_calculateFuelTrimOutput)

Alpha fuel rate result (e2m 104A +8 Alpha_Fuel_Rate, '[APFLRTAP] result of Fuel Rate algorithm'): filters fuel_mass_flow_raw with exponentialMovingAverage (state cold_start_intake_temperature_filter_state, coefficient e2m 104B +C Alpha_Fuel_Rate_Filter_Constant at ROM 0x5be66) into alpha_filtered_fuel_delivery_rate (e2m 104A +14 Filtered_Fuel_Delivery_Rate, LB/HR). Result is a hysteresis on that rate: 1 above alpha_threshold_fuel_rate (e2m 104B +1A C_Alpha_Threshold_Rate), 0 at or below alpha_reset_fuel_rate (e2m 104B +18 C_Alpha_Reset_Rate), else the previous alpha_fuel_rate_result. While alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag is 1 and the filtered rate is above the reset rate, the filter accumulator is first pulled down to the reset rate. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x1000 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0, 0x3fd59c) is set; a 1 lets alpha_base ramp toward 1.0. Shared name with CM550 0xc404 (the same function). (was cm848_calculateSensorEma)

Alpha low speed governor result (e2m 104A +C Alpha_LSG, '[APLSAP] result of LSG algorithm'): a timeout after the low speed governor last acted. While alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag is 1 it reloads alpha_low_speed_governor_timer (e2m 104A +16 Alpha_LSG_Timer) with low_speed_governor_alpha_timeout (e2m 104B +14 LSG_Alpha_Timeout, 'time that must expire without LSG commanding fuel before alpha is one'), sets alpha_low_speed_governor_timer_active_flag and returns 0; while the active flag is set and the timer is above 0 it counts it down by 1 per pass and returns 0; otherwise it clears the active flag and returns 1. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x400 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in pressure_fuel_delay_a_status (0x40a174) and a 1 lets alpha_base ramp toward 1.0. Shared name with CM550 0xc4b2 (the same function). (was cm848_calculateAlphaLowSpeedGovernorResult, earlier cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayA)

Alpha air fuel control result (e2m 104A +6 Alpha_AFC, '[APAFSS] result of AFC algorithm'): a timeout after air fuel control (or the low speed governor) last limited the fuel. While alpha_air_fuel_control_state_detected_flag or alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag is 1 it reloads alpha_air_fuel_control_timer (e2m 104A +18 Alpha_AFC_Timer) with air_fuel_control_alpha_timeout (e2m 104B +6 AFC_Alpha_Timeout, 'time that must elapse without AFC limiting before ALPHA may be set to one'), sets alpha_air_fuel_control_timer_active_flag and returns 0; while the active flag is set and the timer is above 0 it counts it down by 1 per pass and returns 0; otherwise it clears the active flag and returns 1. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x800 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in pressure_fuel_delay_b_status (0x40a16e) and a 1 lets alpha_base ramp toward 1.0. Shared name with CM550 0xc504 (the same function). (was cm848_calculateAlphaAirFuelControlResult, earlier cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayB)

Alpha on governor result (e2m 104A +A Alpha_Governor, '[APGVAP] result of On Governor'): returns 1 while the engine is on a speed governor, that is final_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_VEHICLE_SPEED_LIMIT or cruise_control_engaged_flag is 1, else 0. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x2000 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in fuel_rate_condition_status (0x40a172) and a 1 lets alpha_base ramp toward 1.0. Shared name with CM550 0xc496 (the same function). (was cm848_calculateAlphaOnGovernorResult, earlier cm848_checkFuelRateCondition)

Alpha low ambient air pressure result (e2m 104A +12 Alpha_Low_Ambient_Air_Pressure, '[APAAPRSS] alpha based only on ambient air pressure logic'): a hysteresis on barometric_pressure_reference. Returns 1 (alpha may ramp to 1.0) while it is below alpha_lock_on_barometric_pressure (e2m 104B +10 Alpha_Lock_On_Air_Pressure, 'air pressure below which alpha is ramped to 1'), 0 once it is above alpha_lock_off_barometric_pressure (e2m 104B +E Alpha_Lock_Off_Air_Pressure, 'air pressure after hysteresis to unlock alpha'; ROM 1540 against 1507 for the lock on value), and the previous alpha_low_ambient_air_pressure_result in between. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x8000 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in alpha_low_ambient_air_pressure_result (0x40a17a). Shared name with CM550 0xc556 (the same function). (was cm848_calculateAlphaLowAmbientAirPressureResult, earlier cm848_checkPressureHysteresis)

Fills the 28-byte payload of the J1939 engine configuration message, PGN 65251 (Engine Configuration 1), into the buffer param_1 (fault_timer_state_base; the transmit descriptor j1939_pgn65251_tx_message has its can_id built from 0xfee300 and length 28, set by initFaultTimerMessage at 0x1b900). First it refreshes the torque curve with governor_calculateIntegratorRpmOutput (0x507a20, the fault derate speed points) and cm848_updateProtectionStateMachine (0x20d10). Then, byte swapped to J1939 little endian, it stores: the speeds and percent torques of curve points 1-5 (e2m 1102 Jcomm_Determined_RPM_Point_1-5 at +16 / +12 / +18 / +1A / +14, SPN 188 / 528 / 529 / 530 / 531; the high byte of j1939_indicated_percent_torque_at_* plus 125, SPN 539 .. 543), the high idle speed of point 6 (engine_speed_limit_arbitration.lowest_source_speed_limit, or the droop corrected limit capped at 0xfaff, SPN 532), 0xffff for the endspeed governor gain (SPN 545), reference_engine_torque_working (1102 +1E, SPN 544), the maximum momentary override speed ROM 0x5c39a (e2m 10E7 +18 Jcomm_High_Idle_Override_Speed, SPN 533) and its time limit j1939_pgn61442_engine_overspeed_enable_time_limit / 10 (SPN 534), the speed control range limits governor_rpm_limit_cal / 80 and engine_speed_limit_maximum / 80 (10 rpm per bit, SPN 535 / 536) and the torque control range, 0 percent and the largest point torque (SPN 537 / 538). It sends nothing: cm848_sendFaultTimerMessage (0x1b730, registered for PGN 65251 in the periodic transmit queue) and cm848_processFaultMessageTiming (0x1b778, which resends when a value changed) call it and send the descriptor. Shared name with CM550 0x3320e (the same function). (was faultTimerHandler)

Builds and sends the ECM's own EEC1 broadcast, PGN 61444: the transmit descriptor j1939_pgn61444_tx_message (can_id built from 0xf00400, 5 bytes, set by cm848_initEec1TxDescriptor at 0x25ab8) is registered in the periodic transmit queue with diag_record_queue_add_entry. Byte 1 is the engine torque mode (SPN 899): while a TSC1 override is active (j1939_tsc1_override_state.governor_mode non-zero in the TSC1 fueling states) 0xf6 / 0xf7 / 0xf5 for the sender index 1 / 2 / 3 (transmission / ABS / ASR), otherwise from final_fueling_state: 0xf8 (torque limiting) when torque_derate_fuel_source_code equals it, 0xf0 low speed governor, 0xf2 cruise control, 0xf3 power take-off governor, 0xf4 vehicle speed limit, 0xf9 high speed governor, 0xfa engine brake, 0xf1 accelerator pedal for the other user fueling states, else 0xfe. Byte 2 is the driver demand percent torque plus 125 (cm848_calculateDriverDemandPercentTorque, SPN 512), byte 3 the actual engine percent torque plus 125 (cm848_calculateLoadRateOfChange at 0x209e8, SPN 513; 0xfe when j1939_broadcast_enable_flag is 1) and bytes 4-5 the engine speed (engine_rpm_state_t_0040b7ac.current_rpm, SPN 190). Shared name with CM550 0x32c76 (the same function). (was j1939GetEngineStateCode)

Leaves development mode and turns the RAM refresh back on (J1939 diagnostic service 7): accepted only while j1939_standby_flag is STANDING_BY (e2m 1328 +0 Development_Mode = 1), otherwise it returns DIAG_NACK_NOT_READY. Then it sets j1939_standby_flag = SESSION_ACTIVE (development mode 0), diagnostic_session_state = ACTIVE (e2m 10C7 +0 RAM_Refresh_Enable = 1) and cal_write_mode = 0xee (e2m 0010 +0 RUN_LOC; 0xee is also the start-up value) and returns DIAG_ACK. There is no engine state check; the force variant (service 22, 0x21694) requires the engine to be stopped but not development mode. (was cm848_activateDiagnosticSession) | jlaustill reviewed - hopefully accurate

Enters development mode (J1939 diagnostic service 10, also called by cm848_processPciDiagnosticRequest right after the PCI security key has been accepted): disables the RAM refresh (diagnostic_session_state = INACTIVE, e2m 10C7 +0 RAM_Refresh_Enable = 0), sets j1939_standby_flag = STANDING_BY (e2m 1328 +0 Development_Mode = 1) and cal_write_mode = 0xea (e2m 0010 +0 RUN_LOC), and returns DIAG_ACK. With the refresh off, RAM calibration edits are not overwritten (the refresh pass and the periodic EEPROM mirror reload, cm848_onEepromBlockRead, stop), diagnostic writes to EEPROM addresses and EEPROM parameter ID writes go to the RAM mirror only (cm848_lookupParameterIdAddress, j1939_writeDiagMemory), and the two register address ranges of the diagnostic memory services open (cm848_lookupApplicationMemoryRegionType). The way back is service 7 (0x21624) or, with the engine stopped, service 22 (0x21694). (was cm848_resetDiagnosticSession) | jlaustill review 2026-05-25 - hopefully accurate

Forces an exit from development mode when it is safe to program (J1939 diagnostic service 22): with not_safe_to_program_flag clear (engine stopped) it always turns the RAM refresh on (diagnostic_session_state = ACTIVE, e2m 10C7 +0 RAM_Refresh_Enable = 1) and, only if cal_write_mode is 0xea (development mode), also restores cal_write_mode = 0xee and j1939_standby_flag = SESSION_ACTIVE (e2m 1328 +0 Development_Mode = 0); it returns DIAG_ACK. With the engine not stopped it returns DIAG_NACK_PROTECTED and changes nothing. Unlike service 7 (0x21624) it does not require development mode to be on. (was cm848_forceActivateDiagnosticSession) | jlaustill reviewed 2026-05-25 - frustrated about != 1 and == 0xea/0xee not working as enums
